metadata.case_name: GURUNG CHANDRA KUMAR v. KIN KEI ENGINEERING CO. AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: some form of employment in future

injuries.description: compound fracture of the left tibia and fibula
source: He suffered a compound fracture of the left tibia and fibula; a fracture of the 1st and 2nd lumbar vertebrae with no neurological deficit; a compound fracture of the left 5th metatarsal bone; lung collapse; microscopic haematuria.

injuries.description: fracture of the 1st and 2nd lumbar vertebrae with fusion (spine fused from L1 to L3)
source: (1) his spine has been fused from L1 to L3. Alignment is satisfactory. There is residual surgical scarring. He has a stiff back with marked reduction in the lordotic curvature of the spine. The residual pain and stiffness is expected to persist;
injuries.icd_description: Multiple fractures of lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: compound fracture of the left 5th metatarsal bone
source: He suffered a compound fracture of the left tibia and fibula; a fracture of the 1st and 2nd lumbar vertebrae with no neurological deficit; a compound fracture of the left 5th metatarsal bone; lung collapse; microscopic haematuria.
(3) the fracture of the left 5th metatarsal has healed with good alignment. There is residual impairment of sensation over the lateral half of the left foot;

injuries.description: post-traumatic osteoarthritis of the left ankle resulting in an arthrodesis (the left ankle is fused in neutral position)
source: (2) the compound fracture of the left tibia and fibula has healed in satisfactory alignment. He developed post-traumatic osteoarthritis resulting in an arthrodesis of the ankle: the left ankle is fused in neutral position. There is residual scarring. There is persistent pain in that ankle which may be explained by the fact that there is still some movement in the joint. The residual pain is expected to persist;

manifestations.description: Stiff back with marked reduction in the lordotic curvature of the spine; residual back pain and stiffness expected to persist

Significant wasting of the left thigh muscles due to the disability of that lower leg
Walks using a walking stick as an aid, displaying a limp
Cannot squat or stand only on his left leg
Some reference to a complaint of impotence
